# badger: Decision Record

Use this record when applying [badger](../SKILL.md) to a concrete project decision.

## Context

Badger — embedded, high-performance key-value store written in Go, optimized for LSM-tree with value-log separation.

Badger is a **fast, embeddable Go key-value store** built on an **LSM tree with a separate value log (WiscKey paper)**, giving fast writes and high read performance without external dependencies.
